components.description: Next.js App Router pages and API routes
React components including UI library and dashboard
Database schema defining User, Subscription, RollupSettings, and other models
Email scanning API routes for subscription detection

smoke_checks.title: Production build completes without errors
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'npm run build' and verify build completes successfully with no TypeScript or build errors

smoke_checks.title: Linting passes without errors
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'npm run lint' and verify no ESLint errors are reported

smoke_checks.title: Unit tests pass
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'npm run test' and verify all tests pass. Check crypto.test.ts specifically for encryption/decryption validation

smoke_checks.title: Prisma schema is valid
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'npx prisma validate' and verify the schema.prisma file is valid without errors

smoke_checks.title: Database can be generated
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'npm run db:generate' and verify Prisma client generates successfully

smoke_checks.title: Docker build completes
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'docker build -t prunebox .' and verify the image builds successfully

smoke_checks.title: Development environment starts
smoke_checks.steps: Run 'docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d' and verify all containers (prunebox, postgres) start successfully

smoke_checks.title: Health check endpoint responds
smoke_checks.steps: Start the server and curl 'http://localhost:3001/api/health'. Verify it returns 200 OK

smoke_checks.title: NextAuth configuration is valid
smoke_checks.steps: Read src/modules/auth/auth.config.ts and verify all required environment variables are documented and the configuration exports properly

smoke_checks.title: OAuth tokens are encrypted
smoke_checks.steps: Read src/lib/crypto.ts and verify the encryptToken/decryptToken functions use AES-256-GCM encryption. Run the crypto tests to validate

smoke_checks.title: Environment variables are documented
smoke_checks.steps: Check for .env.example file and verify all sensitive variables (GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, ENCRYPTION_KEY, etc.) are documented

smoke_checks.title: API routes have proper error handling
smoke_checks.steps: Read src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts and src/app/api/scan/route.ts. Verify error responses use consistent error format

smoke_checks.title: Database models match spec schema
smoke_checks.steps: Compare prisma/schema.prisma models against the spec document's SQL schema. Verify User, Subscription, SubscriptionPreference, GmailSyncState, RollupSettings, UnsubscriptionAttempt, and BulkDeletionJob exist with correct fields

smoke_checks.title: Dashboard page renders
smoke_checks.steps: Start the dev server and navigate to http://localhost:3001/dashboard. Verify the page loads without 404 or runtime errors

smoke_checks.title: UI components compile without errors
smoke_checks.steps: Verify all shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui/ are properly exported and TypeScript compiles them without errors

smoke_checks.title: Rate limiter is configured
smoke_checks.steps: Read src/lib/rate-limiter.ts and verify rate limiting logic exists for API endpoints

visual_areas.title: Subscription list display with sender names and email counts
Scan button with progress indicator during email scanning
Settings page with account and preferences
